items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: She was going with Bob Brookmeyer.

ctx.x: Yeah. I thought it was Reeds they called him.

Well, maybe they called him Reeds later, but it's Reed, as far as I know of it. And he had a deformity in one of his legs and they had it in a cast, to straighten it out. And she gave me the extra bedroom and I stayed there for a little while, but I felt very uncomfortable, you know. I felt a draft, by Gerry and I being good friends, you know. I'm living there and she having the dislike for Gerry, you know. So I got out of there in a hurry. But all the while, she was cheating on Gerry. She was going with Bob…

Bob got a little more than the others in the group. I never -- I don't recall having ever seen her again since then. I don't know if she remarried or what. Well, I don't know of any black or white or shall we say Negro or Caucasian, whatever words you want to use that's descriptive, I don't know anyone that would have done that for me. But at that time Gerry was using lightly, you know, and I would go up to Harlem and acquire heroin for him so he wouldn't have to commit himself out in the streets, trying to find…
